perm = [0, 2, 11, 6, 3, 8, 9, 7, 10, 1, 5, 4, 12]

# Verify it's a permutation
assert sorted(perm) == list(range(13)), "Not a permutation!"

# Verify fixed values
assert perm[4] == 3, f"x[4] should be 3, got {perm[4]}"
assert perm[9] == 1, f"x[9] should be 1, got {perm[9]}"

# Verify Costas property
n = len(perm)
vectors = set()
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1, n):
        dc = j - i
        dr = perm[j] - perm[i]
        v = (dc, dr)
        assert v not in vectors, f"Duplicate vector {v} at ({i},{j})"
        vectors.add(v)

print("All checks passed!")
print(f"Solution: {perm}")
print(f"Total displacement vectors: {len(vectors)} (expected {13*12//2})")
